description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] depending on entry damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and [Crystal Force Mode: Lightning] to the user
Crystal Mode: Lightning/Holy Ability Boost, Dualcast Lightning/Holy, Zero Hone Cost to Lightning/Holy Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I: Single-target Lightning/Holy/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, Instant Cast 2 & Quick ATB 1 to user
Crystal Force II: Single-target Lightning/Holy/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, 50% DEF/RES Pierce for 3 turns & Quick ATB 1 to user; After using Crystal Force II, grants [Cap Break Level 1, Lightning/Holy Ability Damage +30%, Quick Lightning/Holy & Dualcast Lightning/Holy] for 3 turns to user
